summary: NanoClaw is a personal-assistant orchestrator: a Node host routes chat messages into per-session SQLite mailboxes and spawns a Docker container per agent group; the container-side agent-runner (Bun, container/agent-runner/src/index.ts) polls /workspace/inbound.db, formats the batch into a prompt, and calls the model through the Claude provider (@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.280, which spawns the pinned @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.280 native CLI at the hardcoded path /pnpm/claude with permissionMode=bypassPermissions), then writes replies to /workspace/outbound.db. The host needs Docker and a credential gateway, so inside a sandbox the runnable entrypoint is the agent-runner itself. The overlay installs Bun, Node, the Claude Code CLI and the repo under /opt/harness and adds a small host stand-in, nanoclaw-run-task, that links /workspace/agent to the task cwd, seeds the two mailboxes (using the harness's own src/mailbox/sqlite/schema.ts) with one chat message plus a `user` destination, runs `bun run .../agent-runner/src/index.ts`, waits for the message ack and the reply row, prints the reply, and stores logs, mailboxes and the Claude transcript under /out. Model calls go from the Claude Code CLI to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$PROXY_URL (Anthropic messages API, streaming, tools).
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

# NanoClaw overlay: runs the container-side agent-runner (Bun) directly, with
# the Claude Code CLI it drives, all self-contained under /opt/harness.
# The base image's own python/node/toolchain is left untouched.
ARG BUN_VERSION=1.4.0
ARG NODE_VERSION=22.20.0
ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.280
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git unzip xz-utils bash procps \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Bun runtime (the agent-runner is bun-only: bun:sqlite, TS executed directly).
RUN set -eux; arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$arch" in amd64) b=bun-linux-x64-baseline;; arm64) b=bun-linux-aarch64;; *) echo "unsupported arch $arch"; exit 1;; esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/bun/bin /tmp/bun; \
    curl -fsSL -o /tmp/bun.zip "https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v${BUN_VERSION}/${b}.zip"; \
    unzip -q /tmp/bun.zip -d /tmp/bun; \
    mv "/tmp/bun/${b}/bun" /opt/harness/bun/bin/bun; chmod 0755 /opt/harness/bun/bin/bun; \
    rm -rf /tmp/bun /tmp/bun.zip

# Node (build-time npm for the Claude Code package; also available to the agent).
RUN set -eux; arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$arch" in amd64) n=x64;; arm64) n=arm64;; *) echo "unsupported arch $arch"; exit 1;; esac; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${n}.tar.xz" | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness; \
    mv "/opt/harness/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${n}" /opt/harness/node

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/bun/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH

# Claude Code CLI, pinned exactly as container/cli-tools.json pins it. The
# package's postinstall places the native binary at bin/claude.exe. The
# agent-runner hardcodes pathToClaudeCodeExecutable=/pnpm/claude (the pnpm
# global shim path in the stock image), so that path is provided as a symlink.
RUN set -eux; mkdir -p /opt/harness/claude-code /opt/harness/bin /pnpm; cd /opt/harness/claude-code; \
    npm install --no-fund --no-audit --loglevel=error "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}"; \
    ln -sf /opt/harness/claude-code/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/bin/claude.exe /opt/harness/bin/claude; \
    ln -sf /opt/harness/bin/claude /pnpm/claude; \
    /opt/harness/bin/claude --version

# Harness source (never modified) + the agent-runner's pinned deps from bun.lock.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN set -eux; cd /opt/harness/src/container/agent-runner; \
    bun install --frozen-lockfile; \
    rm -rf /opt/harness/src/.git
ENV NANOCLAW_SRC=/opt/harness/src

# Mount points the runner expects (/workspace/agent is linked to the task dir at run time).
RUN mkdir -p /workspace/outbox /workspace/inbox /out && chmod -R 0777 /workspace /out

# Host-side stand-in: seeds the session mailboxes with one task, runs the
# agent-runner, waits for the reply, writes logs/transcripts under /out.
RUN set -eux; mkdir -p /opt/harness/libexec /etc/profile.d; \
    echo '' | base64 -d > /opt/harness/libexec/nanoclaw-run-task.ts; \
    printf '#!/bin/bash\nexport PATH="/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/bun/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH"\nexec /opt/harness/bun/bin/bun /opt/harness/libexec/nanoclaw-run-task.ts "$@"\n' > /opt/harness/bin/nanoclaw-run-task; \
    chmod 0755 /opt/harness/bin/nanoclaw-run-task; \
    printf 'export PATH="/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/bun/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH"\n' > /etc/profile.d/harness-path.sh
# (/etc/profile.d: Debian's /etc/profile overwrites PATH for login shells such
#  as `bash -lc`, which would otherwise hide the harness binaries.)

# Non-interactive, no telemetry, no updater; IS_SANDBOX lets Claude Code accept
# bypassPermissions when the container runs as root.
ENV CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 \
    DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 \
    DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 \
    DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING=1 \
    IS_SANDBOX=1 \
    TZ=UTC
notes: Verified locally (Docker 29, arm64) on both python:3.12-slim-bookworm and buildpack-deps:jammy: builds succeed, the check command passes under `bash -lc`, and a task run against a mock Anthropic-API proxy executed a Bash tool call, created a file in the task dir, returned the reply on stdout, and left only task files behind (with cwd=/work and cwd=/app). Proxy saw only POST /v1/messages (streaming, model=claude-sonnet-4-5) plus one harmless HEAD /api/hello connectivity probe. Design: NanoClaw's Node host cannot run in a sandbox (needs Docker + a credential gateway), so the run command drives the real container agent-runner (bun, unmodified, at /opt/harness/src/container/agent-runner/src/index.ts) via nanoclaw-run-task, a ~300-line Bun script embedded base64 in the Dockerfile (the repo is never touched). It symlinks the hardcoded /workspace/agent to the task cwd, writes container.json + a CLAUDE.md composed from the harness's own container/CLAUDE.md and core tool instructions (only if the task dir lacks them; removed afterwards, copies kept in /out), seeds inbound.db/outbound.db from src/mailbox/sqlite/schema.ts with one 'chat' message and a `user` destination, and exits when the runner acks the message and a reply row lands (or the runner idles NANOCLAW_TASK_IDLE seconds after the ack; hard cap NANOCLAW_TASK_TIMEOUT, exit 124). Outputs in /out: result.json, messages_out.json, agent-runner.log, inbound.db/outbound.db, memory/, and claude-config/projects/<cwd>/<session>.jsonl (the Claude Code transcript; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is pointed at /out/claude-config unless preset). Model: the wrapper writes NANOCLAW_MODEL (fallback ANTHROPIC_MODEL) into container.json, which the provider passes to the SDK; any claude-* name works since the proxy substitutes. Caveats: the runner refuses to run if /workspace/agent exists as a real directory or stale mailbox files exist without its marker; the runner's SessionStart memory hook (hardcoded `bun /app/src/memory/hook.ts`) fails non-blockingly since /app/src is not provided (deliberately, to avoid colliding with task images whose WORKDIR is /app); NanoClaw MCP tools that need the host (ncl CLI, ask_user_question, install_packages, create_agent) are present but have no host to answer, and the composed persona tells the agent not to ask questions. Node 22.20.0 is installed only for npm at build time; the claude CLI is a native binary. bun x64 uses the baseline build for CPUs without AVX2.
